cards.claim: The Empire of Haiti was established on September 22, 1804.
cards.quote: The Governor-General of Haiti, Jean-Jacques Dessalines, created the empire on September 22, 1804.

cards.claim: The Empire of Haiti was established on August 26, 1849.
cards.quote: Second Empire of Haiti The Second Haitian Empire, officially known as the Empire of Haiti (French: "Empire d'Haïti"; Haitian Creole: "Anpi an Ayiti"), was a state which existed from 1849 to 1859. It was established by the then-President, former Lieutenant General and Supreme Commander of the Presidential Guards under President Riché, Faustin Soulouque, who, inspired by Napoleon I, declared himself Emperor Faustin I of Haiti on August 26, 1849 at the Cathedral of Our Lady of the Assumption in Port-au-Prince.
